payload.rationale: Reading this as a head-to-head speed race. The same objective and the same tolerance answered two ways, a full Monte-Carlo sweep against a reduced-order path, with every evaluation on both sides run through the selected solver and both wall clocks measured live. I will run the two lanes concurrently, show the polar forming on each, and report the agreement and the measured speedup.
evidence: frames a head-to-head comparison of two methods on one objective
names a full sweep against a reduced-order path

payload.message: • One smooth parameter, steady regime: a few anchors pin the curve. • Rejected: single point (prices one setting as the range); a fine grid (cost, no info).
• The landscape is smooth, so any search method lands on the same optimum. • The ensemble sweep also maps the whole trade. • Both lanes solve with VSPAERO.

• Two ways to find one smooth peak: sweep the whole ensemble with Monte Carlo, or solve in a reduced order space. • The only honest question is what each path costs. • So we run them side by side and measure.
